projects.title: Enterprise AI Knowledge Assistant (LLM + RAG Platform)
projects.description: Developed an enterprise AI assistant capable of answering domain-specific queries using LLM-powered retrieval pipelines and semantic search. Executed vector search using Pinecone embeddings enabling contextual retrieval across thousands of enterprise documents. Deployed containerized inference services using Docker and AWS EC2, supporting scalable conversational AI workflows.
projects.longDescription: Developed an enterprise AI assistant capable of answering domain-specific queries using LLM-powered retrieval pipelines and semantic search. Executed vector search using Pinecone embeddings enabling contextual retrieval across thousands of enterprise documents. Deployed containerized inference services using Docker and AWS EC2, supporting scalable conversational AI workflows.

projects.title: Intelligent Document Processing System
projects.description: Built an AI-powered document analysis pipeline capable of extracting and classifying information from financial documents using transformer-based NLP models. Achieved 91% classification accuracy and reduced manual document processing time by 60% through computerized entity extraction and feature engineering.
projects.longDescription: Built an AI-powered document analysis pipeline capable of extracting and classifying information from financial documents using transformer-based NLP models. Achieved 91% classification accuracy and reduced manual document processing time by 60% through computerized entity extraction and feature engineering.

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis Web App with SageMaker
projects.description: Built a sentiment analysis web application using AWS SageMaker for model training and deployment, with a Python and HTML frontend for real-time text classification and sentiment prediction.
